instruction.text: Choose the verbs with the correct suffixes to complete the sentences.

atoms.a: They are playing hide and seek
The dog is swimming in the pool.
atoms.b: The dog is ((swimmed ++swimming)) in the pool.

atoms.a: She talked to her friend on the phone for a long time.
atoms.b: She ((++talked talking)) to her friend on the phone for a long time.

atoms.a: I remember hearing about the party.

instruction.text: Write the correct suffixes to fill in the gaps and complete the sentences.

atoms.a: At the weekend, my dad cooked us chicken and rice.
atoms.b: At the weekend, my dad cook((ed)) us chicken and rice.

atoms.a: I love watching good acting at the theatre.
atoms.b: I love watch((ing)) good act((ing)) at the theatre.

atoms.a: We laughed a lot when we went swimming.
atoms.b: We laugh((ed)) a lot when we went swimm((ing)).

atoms.a: My little brother did a painting for me.
atoms.b: My little brother did a paint((ing)) for me.
